shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a rectangular island stands between a sink counter and a refrigerator, with a window along one side and an aisle along the opposite side. A woman in an orange shirt sits on the refrigerator-side window stool and proposes making a stew from leftover ingredients, while a man in a white shirt sits on the sink-side window stool and a woman in a blue shirt sits on the sink-end stool.
